t35: No queue waiting: the difference of chip-free play
t36: Many online backgammon games require chips to sit at a table; when your chips run out, you wait or pay. In a chip-free setup, losing doesn't kick you out — you can play ten matches in a row with your friend.
t37: This makes a big difference especially in friend matches: playing series is much more fun than single games and gives a real answer to "who's better."
